description: This file defines classes and functions related to trigger decoding in engine control firmware, including TriggerState classes, trigger event handling, and synchronization logic.

classes.name: TriggerState
classes.description: Represents the current state of trigger decoding, including synchronization, event counters, and cycle data.

classes.name: TriggerStateWithRunningStatistics
classes.description: Extends TriggerState to include real-time RPM calculations and timestamp tracking for trigger events.

methods.name: isTriggerDecoderError
methods.description: Checks if there is an error in trigger decoding.

methods.name: calculateTriggerSynchPoint
methods.description: Calculates the synchronization point for trigger decoding.

methods.name: findTriggerZeroEventIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of the trigger zero event.

methods.name: getEngineCycle
methods.description: Returns the engine cycle based on operation mode.
